summary: Inspect a supplied two-qubit density matrix, its reductions and partial-transpose spectrum with the exact 2×2 Peres-Horodecki separability boundary.
objective: Inspect a supplied two-qubit density matrix, its reductions and partial-transpose spectrum with the exact 2×2 Peres-Horodecki separability boundary.
intent_signals: Inspect a mixed two-qubit state with partial transpose and reduced states.
Show why two local Bloch vectors do not encode joint entanglement.
example_prompts: Inspect a mixed two-qubit state with partial transpose and reduced states.
not_for: Encoding a two-qubit state as one Bloch vector.

entities.name: Joint matrix
entities.guidance: Show all 16 complex entries in basis |00>,|01>,|10>,|11> with Hermiticity and eigenvalue checks.

entities.name: Partial transpose
entities.guidance: For T_B map rho_(i j,k l) to rho_(i l,k j) and preserve tensor labels.

entities.name: Marginals
entities.guidance: Show separate rho_A and rho_B Bloch vectors beside joint/PPT spectra.

state_contract.model: Accept one finite complex 4×4 rho in declared |q_A q_B> order and one finite eps in [1e-12,1e-6]. Use this same eps for Hermiticity, trace, input-spectrum residual and partial-transpose verdict policy. Reject an input eigenvalue below -eps; if the minimum lies in [-eps,eps], accept only as approximately PSD with the residual visible and do not silently project or certify exact positivity. Form rho_A and rho_B by partial trace. Form rho^(T_B)_(i j,k l)=rho_(i l,k j); compute Hermitian eigenvalues. Classify lambda_min<-eps as NPT and entangled; lambda_min>eps as positive/PPT within the declared eigensolver and tolerance, which invokes the 2x2 separability theorem at the mathematical model boundary; classify [-eps,eps] as numerically unresolved. Exact analytic presets may separately carry their proven boundary verdict. Optional negativity N=(||rho^(T_B)||_1-1)/2 is a diagnostic, not a universal operational resource claim. Presets include maximally mixed, product mixture, Bell pure state and Werner rho_W=p|Psi-><Psi-|+(1-p)I/4 with p in [0,1].
state_contract.authority: Supplied finite tensors, ordered identifiers, basis conventions and provenance own semantic state. Blender/glTF assets are display-only; Three.js owns validation, calculation, linked selection, failure states and exact reset.
actions: Select an element and view its partial-transpose destination.
Sweep a bounded Werner p preset.
Reset rho, tensor order, tolerance and selection.

invariants: rho and both reductions are Hermitian, trace one and PSD within declared tolerance.
Partial transpose is an index permutation, remains Hermitian and trace one, and does not mutate rho.

For two qubits, lambda_min<-eps is a numerical NPT entanglement result, lambda_min>eps is a numerical PPT-side result governed by the 2x2 theorem, and [-eps,eps] remains unresolved unless an exact analytic preset supplies the verdict.
A passive qubit-order change permutes rho, reductions, labels and transpose subsystem together.
motion_guidance: Werner-parameter motion recomputes the matrix and spectra analytically; it is not decoherence or laboratory time.
creative_affordances: Choose any coherent laboratory, constellation or sculptural art direction while preserving exact labels, selectable identity and non-color encodings.
known_limits: Documentary authored recipe only; no model training, checkpoint execution, quantum hardware, Blender export, browser, renderer or interactive runtime was run.
glTF transports neutral display assets only; tensors, checkpoints, citations, basis order, dtype and provenance remain external data.

claims.statement: Peres proved that positivity of the partial transpose is a necessary condition for a bipartite density matrix to be separable.
claims.scope: Finite bipartite states; necessity alone is not general sufficiency.

source_refs.locator: Abstract and equations (1)-(4), definition and positivity of the partially transposed matrix

claims.statement: The Horodeckis proved that positivity under partial transpose is necessary and sufficient for separability in 2×2 and 2×3 systems, while it is not sufficient in general.
claims.scope: The 2×2 result applies to this two-qubit recipe; no higher-dimensional sufficiency claim.

object_craft.structure: Blender authors two marginal ball frames and paired 4×4 matrix lattices at neutral transforms; glTF contains no quantum state.
object_craft.material: Signed eigenvalue glyphs use shape plus color; the tolerance band has its own hatch and label.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js owns complex matrices, tensor indexing, partial trace/transpose, Hermitian eigensolve, preset sweep and reset.

physical_contract.scope: Finite imported-data calculation and explanatory playback; no physical dynamics, model training, quantum device or causal attribution.
